summary: Elevate your career with CP3P training. Gain essential skills in public-private partnerships and become a certified professional in this growing field.
lede: Public-private partnership training helps infrastructure, finance, procurement, legal, and contract teams assess projects and prepare them for procurement and delivery. Participants practise project screening, affordability and value-for-money analysis, risk allocation, and bid evaluation. They also develop appraisal memos and contract management plans, and explore market sounding, lender considerations, and AI-assisted document review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work on infrastructure projects, PPP transactions, procurement, finance, legal review, or contract administration and need a practical CP3P framework they can apply immediately.
modules: Project Screening with PPP Certification Guide
prerequisites: You will need a laptop, spreadsheet software, and the ability to review project briefs, procurement documents, and contract excerpts during exercises. Prior exposure to public finance, infrastructure procurement, or project appraisal will help you move faster through the CP3P case work.
